style_summary: A dense neo-editorial poster system that layers monumental white filled and outlined typography behind a centered surreal photographic cutout sculpture, then frames it with technical microcopy, serial numbers, ruled panels, small warning labels, celestial symbols, and coarse vintage print grain on a deep black field.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: The monumental central subject or surreal object assemblage
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: The subject's symbolic action or transformation
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: Objects, materials, tools, or props fused into the central collage
environment_variables.LOCATION: The poster environment or implied setting
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: Secondary imagery, diagrams, labels, or supporting collage fragments
environment_variables.MAIN_TEXT: Short oversized headline repeated as filled and outlined display type
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: Small editorial microcopy, serial data, or dossier captions
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: A simple celestial, directional, or technical separator symbol
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: Human styling direction, material draping, or a no-people styling note
environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: Observable visual traits that must remain visible
environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: Literal source content and identity marks that generated samples must not recreate

style_fidelity_anchors: Deep black poster field with dense edge-to-edge editorial information and very little empty space.
Monumental white uppercase sans-serif headline repeated in stacked rows, alternating solid fill, thin outline, and reversed or mirrored treatments.
One centered surreal photographic cutout sculpture occupying roughly two-thirds of the frame and overlapping the background type.
Front-facing montage perspective with shallow layered depth, crisp cutout contours, and an iconic monument-like silhouette.
Restricted palette led by black and off-white, with rust orange and cool cyan inside the hero collage plus tiny yellow and red warning accents.
Top utility strip and bottom dossier panel built from thin rules, small labels, serial numbers, pseudo-technical diagrams, and barcode-like line textures.
Small celestial and navigational symbols such as four-point stars, orbital rings, arrows, and symmetrical ornaments used as separators.
Coarse halftone, photocopy grain, ink speckle, slight registration drift, and softened photographic detail across the whole poster.
High-contrast flat poster lighting combined with localized glossy highlights on the central photographic materials.
Layered editorial typography remains partially obscured by the hero object while the short main words stay recognizable.
Mood combines underground music-poster energy, speculative spiritual symbolism, Y2K editorial graphics, and archival warning-label precision.
source_content_to_avoid: The original side-profile human head or bust wrapped in striped orange and cyan fabric.
White doves or pigeons flying around the figure, red flowers placed in the face collage, and moon-like spheres in the same arrangement.
The exact phrases DON’T CRY, DON’T YOU CRY, SILENT KILLERS, CRYTHINGS.CO, or any copied mental-health explanatory text.
The yellow DON’T CRY placard, the handwritten signature above the headline, and the small circular face icons.
The source poster's exact stacked word order, identical silhouette, matching crop, or the same symbolic narrative.
The visible serial numbers, year marks, rating-style label, trademark sign, barcode, and footer ornaments from the source.
Any real organization name, campaign identity, brand logo, watermark, username, creator signature, platform mark, or QR code.
Identifiable real people, celebrity likenesses, copied faces, or protected album and campaign artwork.

visual_deconstruction.overall_style_category: Neo-editorial surreal photo-collage poster with Y2K dossier graphics and vintage photocopied zine texture.
visual_deconstruction.composition_and_layout: A dense rectangular poster grid: a narrow utility strip at the top, three or four oversized headline rows behind the subject, one monumental central collage, small side data blocks, a boxed dossier footer, and a final microcopy line with symmetric ornaments.
visual_deconstruction.subject_placement: The hero collage is centered, vertically dominant, and allowed to obscure large portions of the display typography while leaving enough outer letterforms visible to establish repetition.
visual_deconstruction.camera_or_perspective: Straight-on cutout montage with shallow overlap rather than a deep photographic scene; spherical fragments and draped materials add localized volume.
visual_deconstruction.typography_style: Extra-bold grotesk uppercase mixed with oversized monoline outline duplicates, occasional reversal or mirroring, compact utility sans text, serial numerals, and one small expressive label accent.
visual_deconstruction.color_palette_behavior: Black and warm white carry most of the page; the central object concentrates rust orange and desaturated cyan; yellow and red appear only as small high-priority labels or botanical-like accents.
visual_deconstruction.graphic_elements: Thin rules, framed panels, orbital rings, four-point stars, arrows, serial codes, technical stamps, barcode-like line fields, symmetrical footer ornaments, and small geometric badges.
visual_deconstruction.texture_and_finish: Visible halftone dots, paper tooth, photocopy noise, coarse screen-print grain, mild edge wear, muted photo detail, and slight color misregistration.
visual_deconstruction.lighting: Hard editorial contrast with flattened black shadows, pale highlights, and selective gloss on metallic, glass, or satin collage materials.
visual_deconstruction.mood_and_cultural_reference: Underground music flyer, speculative archive, fashion-editorial collage, spiritual sci-fi symbolism, and turn-of-the-century graphic design.
visual_deconstruction.reusable_design_rules: Keep one iconic surreal object at the center, let oversized repeated words behave as architecture, concentrate color in the collage, and organize all small information inside disciplined utility bands.
visual_deconstruction.things_to_avoid: Do not simplify into a clean Swiss poster, expand into a cinematic scene, use soft pastel minimalism, reproduce the source portrait-and-doves narrative, or add real brand identity.

composition.primary_structure: One monumental central cutout assemblage over three or four stacked rows of repeated megatype.
composition.layout_grid: Use a narrow top utility bar, a dense central poster field, paired side data blocks, a ruled lower dossier panel, and a final ornamented footer line.
composition.subject_scale: The hero occupies about 60 to 72 percent of the frame height and overlaps both solid and outline type.
composition.negative_space: Keep negative space low; breathing room comes from black counters inside outline letters and thin gaps between framed information bands.
composition.depth: Use shallow paper-collage layering, partial occlusion, cutout overlaps, circular orbital fragments, and a few crisp contact shadows.
composition.aspect_adaptation: For 4:5, stack the headline vertically and elongate the hero; for 5:4, widen the repeated type rows and spread technical side panels while keeping the hero centered.

typography.headline: Two to three short uppercase words set in a massive bold grotesk, repeated across the field with alternating solid white and thin white outline variants.
typography.secondary_display: One compact black-on-yellow or white-on-red warning label may overlap the hero object.
typography.supporting_text: Tiny all-caps dossier captions, serial numerals, compact paragraphs, and utility labels aligned to thin rules.
typography.alignment: Mostly centered display type with disciplined left and right technical blocks; allow deliberate reversal or mirroring in one background row.
typography.restrictions: Use only original short phrases and invented data; never copy source slogans, signatures, organization names, or serial numbers.

color_palette.secondary: Warm off-white for display type, rules, symbols, and dossier panels.
color_palette.hero_colors: Rust orange, burnt sienna, and desaturated cyan or oxidized teal concentrated inside the central collage.
color_palette.accents: Small signal-yellow labels and restrained crimson fragments.
color_palette.proportions: Approximately 55 percent black, 25 percent off-white, 12 percent rust orange, 6 percent cyan, and 2 percent yellow or red accents.

image_treatment.rendering_mode: Raster photo-collage combining photographic object cutouts with flat editorial typography and technical graphic overlays.
image_treatment.edge_quality: Crisp hand-cut contours softened by consistent halftone and print grain rather than smooth vector perfection.
image_treatment.lighting: Hard frontal editorial light with controlled highlights and compressed shadow detail.
image_treatment.finish: A tactile offset-print and photocopy finish with mild ink spread, paper tooth, and subtle registration drift while preserving clear silhouettes.
image_treatment.legibility: Keep the primary headline and warning label readable; treat the smallest microcopy and serial data as disciplined visual texture.

design_rules: Build the poster around one central surreal assemblage with a strong, readable monument-like silhouette.
Place oversized repeated headline words behind the subject and alternate solid, outline, and reversed treatments.
Keep black and off-white dominant while concentrating rust orange and cyan inside the central collage.
Use yellow or red only for one or two small warning-style accents.
Frame small text and data inside strict ruled bands so dense information still feels intentional.
Apply one coherent halftone and photocopy texture across photography, type, and graphic elements.
Use orbital circles, stars, arrows, and technical separators sparingly to connect the collage to the dossier grid.
Change every literal subject, phrase, symbol combination, identifier, and narrative from the source.
do: Use a centered cutout object sculpture that breaks across multiple type rows.
Repeat a short original headline in bold filled and monoline outline variants.
Balance expressive surreal imagery with disciplined technical framing.
Keep the poster tactile, grainy, high-contrast, and densely layered.
Adapt the same hierarchy to both 4:5 and 5:4 without turning the horizontal version into a different genre.
avoid: Do not recreate the source portrait, white birds, red flower placement, moon arrangement, slogans, signature, or footer data.
Do not include real logos, brand names, watermarks, usernames, QR codes, or copied identity marks.
Do not render a clean vector poster, glossy 3D scene, soft minimalist layout, or photoreal cinematic environment.
Do not scatter many unrelated objects until the central silhouette becomes unreadable.
Do not let artificial noise destroy the primary headline, hero contours, or main warning label.
negative_prompt: source portrait, side-profile human head, white doves, pigeons, copied red-flower placement, copied moon arrangement, DON’T CRY, SILENT KILLERS, copied slogan, copied signature, real logo, brand name, watermark, username, platform mark, QR code, real barcode, identifiable person, celebrity likeness, album-cover copy, campaign-art copy, clean vector poster, glossy 3D render, cinematic scene, pastel minimalism, excessive glitch, destructive noise, unreadable primary headline, low resolution, blur, muddy silhouette, random object clutter
